title: The Empty Glass Case
synopsis: Today the museum will show a new piece of Rome's ancient marble map.
But this morning, its glass case is empty.
goal: Find out when the piece went missing, and what the thief left behind.

options.label: The lights went off for ten minutes.
An alarm rang in the hall.
options.feedback: Nobody talked about an alarm. Find two people who say the same thing.

options.label: The power was cut.
options.feedback: Sofia says the power stayed on. What did Enzo and Livia see?

notes: Played as a talk (DialogueScene) in the guard room: Enzo and Livia both saw the lights go off at midnight; Sofia says the power stayed on (paid off by the final: the switch was turned by hand).
Livia's answer to 'Where were you at midnight?' (in her lab, working late) is heard after the deduction (then): the Owl's first slip, paid off in Case 08 M2.

learning.objective: 세 사람에게 같은 질문을 하고, 자정에 대해 두 사람이 같은 것을 말한 진술(the lights went off)을 찾는다.
expressions: When did you last see the piece?
The lights went off for ten minutes.
I worked late in my lab.

play.title: The Night Log
story: Director Sofia Ferri meets you at the door.
"The new map piece is gone!" she says.
Three people can tell you about last night.
play.letter:
Ask each person what they saw.
Find two people who say the same thing about midnight.
play.question: What happened in the map hall at midnight?
hints: Ask every person the same question: What happened at midnight?
Two people saw the same thing. Compare their answers.
play.successMessage: Two witnesses saw the same thing!
transition: At midnight, the hall was dark for ten minutes.
Someone could take the piece then, and nobody would see.
Enzo hands you his night log.
Giulia, your guide, waves from the map hall. "Come and look at the floor!"

clue.title: The Dark Ten Minutes
clue.note: Enzo and Livia saw the lights go off at midnight, for ten minutes.

discovery.title: THE DARK TEN MINUTES
discovery.detail: The piece was safe at ten. Then, at midnight, the hall went dark.

notes: Letter: Giulia's notes on a trail of white dust, written out of order with starts, ends, after and before.

clueInputs.note: The trail was left in the dark ten minutes.

learning.objective: starts, ends, after, before를 읽고 먼지 자국이 지나간 곳을 순서대로 놓는다.
expressions: It starts at the empty case.
After the case, it goes past the big statue.
Before the back door, it goes down the stairs.

play.title: The Dust Trail
story: On the floor, there is a line of fine white dust.
Livia Conti, a young restorer, kneels down. "Strange," she says softly.
Giulia writes down where the dust goes.
play.letter:
The dust trail ends at the back door.
It starts at the empty case.
After the case, it goes past the big statue.
Before the back door, it goes down the stairs.
play.question: Follow the dust. Put the places in order, from start to end.
hints: One line tells you where the trail starts.
Before the back door means just before the end.
transition: The dust is soft, like chalk. Livia looks at it for a long time.
At the back door, something small is waiting.
play.orderFeedback: Find where the trail starts. Then read After and Before.

clue.title: The Dust Trail
clue.note: A trail of fine white dust runs from the empty case to the back door.

evidence.name: White Dust
evidence.description: Fine white dust from the map hall floor. It is soft, like chalk.

lines.text: The dust goes all over the hall!
Where does it start and end?
I wrote it down. But my notes are all mixed up!

discovery.title: A TRAIL TO THE BACK DOOR
discovery.detail: Someone carried something out that way. What is waiting at the door?

options.label: The Pantheon
options.feedback: This place has a round hole in its roof. Where do people throw coins?

options.label: The Colosseum
options.feedback: This is where the old games were. Where do people make a wish?

notes: Played as a look round (ExploreScene) in the map hall: the dust leads to the back door, where the Owl's card lies; the visitor map board opens once it is read, and its three place pictures are told apart by what people do there (a girl throws a coin into the fountain).
The choice pictures reuse two place pictures (trevi_fountain, pantheon_hall) and add one (colosseum), all 1536x1024.

Coordinates measured on the made map_hall.png (1536x1024, sha256 266bb26b88598120…) with a 100px grid overlay, STEP 3-15B B1. The card is drawn small at the door's foot: its area takes in the floor around it. The middle window is split around the statue's head.

clueInputs.note: The trail ends at the back door, where the card is.

learning.objective: 부엉이 카드의 'throw coins and make a wish'를 읽고, 방문객 지도의 세 그림 중 사람들이 동전을 던지는 곳을 고른다.

play.title: The Owl's Card
story: The dust trail ends at the heavy back door.
Something small and white lies on the floor there.
An owl card? Or just a ticket?
play.letterIntro: Under the back door, a card with an owl stamp:
play.letter:
Dear Detective,
The piece is not lost.
Go where people throw coins and make a wish.
Look under the second shell.
— The Owl
play.question: Where does the Owl want you to go?
hints: Find the card at the back door and read it first.
Look at each picture on the visitor map. Where are people throwing coins?
transition: The Owl wants you at the fountain of wishes.
"The piece is not lost?" Sofia says. "Then where is it?"
Behind her, Signor Bruno Valli, the show's sponsor, is red in the face.

discovery.title: THE FOUNTAIN OF WISHES
discovery.detail: The Owl says the piece is not lost. Next stop: the Trevi Fountain.

notes: The Owl put a lock on the light box. Its three numbers are the case's three clues: 4 places on the trail, 2 people who saw the lights go off (Enzo and Livia; Sofia says the power stayed on), the second shell.

clueInputs.note: First number: the trail passes 4 places.
Second number: Enzo and Livia saw the lights go off.

learning.objective: 세 단서(먼지 자국, 증인 진술, 부엉이 카드)를 다시 확인해 숫자 4·2·2를 순서대로 맞춘다.
expressions: How many places did my trail pass?
How many people saw the lights go off?

play.title: The Light Box
story: The big light box is in the guard room.
Someone put a new lock on it, with three dials.
A tag with an owl stamp hangs from the lock.
play.letter:
My lock is made of your first clues, Detective.
First number: How many places did my dust trail pass?
Second number: How many people saw the lights go off at midnight?
Third number: Which shell did I write about on my card?
— The Owl
play.question: Turn the dials to the Owl's three numbers. Then open the light box.
hints: Your notebook has the dust trail. Count its places.
Open your witness notes. Who saw the lights go off?
transition: White dust on the switch, and an owl card at the door.
Somebody planned the dark ten minutes.
Giulia holds up the Owl's card. "To the Trevi Fountain!"

feedback.322: Count the places on the trail again. The empty case is one of them.
feedback.412: Open your witness notes. More than one person saw the lights go off.
feedback.423: Read the Owl's card again. Which shell?
feedback.432: Count again. Who saw the lights go off? Not Sofia.

play.orderFeedback: These numbers fit, but not in this order. Trail, witnesses, then the shell.

intro: Rome. The morning sun is warm on the old stones.
Today the Capitoline Museums will show a new piece of an ancient marble map.
But the glass case is empty!
"Please, Detective," says Director Sofia Ferri. "Help us find it!"
play.caseSummary: The piece went missing at midnight, in ten dark minutes. Enzo and Livia saw the lights go off. But the power stayed on: someone turned the lights off by hand. A white dust trail led to the back door. There, the Owl left a card: the piece is not lost.

notes: STEP 3-11 trial season (Rome), planned by Claude Code with tool/season_planner/PLAYBOOK.md.
The white dust (s3_ep01_e2) is plaster from the copy Livia carried out: it pays off in Case 03 and Case 04.

STEP 3-14: M1 is now a talk with three witnesses (Enzo, Sofia, Livia) and M3 a look round the map hall ending in a picture choice. Enzo's night log (s3_ep01_e1) is still the evidence of M1, handed over after the talk. Livia's 'I worked late in my lab' is paid off in Case 08.
